limitations: Requested masses and exact moments of inertia still require selected hardware and manufactured geometry
Head/foot/beak shell area approximation can over/underestimate cavity volume; inner ribs and seats are unresolved
Pose grid is algebraic, not joint-limit or collision validated, and excludes acceleration, shock, friction and thermal duty
Leg torque, support/contact dynamics, seated grasp and walking are not tested here
50 N opposed bite load is an internal jaw load path; only specified 50 g payload and 2 N external drag are added
Catalog screening torque is not a measured continuous thermal rating
